mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (title, category, file_id, doc_type, version_no, checksum, status, index_status, source_url, effective_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{fileId}, #{docType}, #{versionNo}, #{checksum}, #{status}, #{indexStatus}, #{sourceUrl}, #{effectiveAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_document WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status=#{status}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=0

UPDATE knowledge_document SET index_status=#{indexStatus}, index_error=#{indexError}, chunk_count=COALESCE(#{chunkCount}, chunk_count), published_at=COALESCE(#{publishedAt}, published_at) WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_document SET is_deleted=1, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, vector_id, content, content_hash, char_count, metadata, enabled) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{vectorId}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{charCount}, #{metadata}, #{enabled})

INSERT INTO ai_index_job (document_id, document_version, job_type, status, idempotency_key, progress, total_chunks, processed_chunks, requested_by, started_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{documentVersion}, #{jobType}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{progress}, #{totalChunks}, #{processedChunks}, #{requestedBy}, #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_index_job WHERE status IN (0,1) AND external_job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_index_job SET progress=COALESCE(#{progress}, progress), total_chunks=COALESCE(#{totalChunks}, total_chunks), processed_chunks=COALESCE(#{processedChunks}, processed_chunks), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE ai_index_job SET status=2, progress=COALESCE(#{progress}, 100), total_chunks=COALESCE(#{totalChunks}, total_chunks), processed_chunks=COALESCE(#{totalChunks}, processed_chunks), finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_index_job SET status=3, error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
